title: Structure-based molecular hybridization design of Keap1-Nrf2 inhibitors as novel protective agents of acute lung injury.
authors: Zhang, Le; Xu, Lijuan; Chen, Haihu; Zhang, Wannian; Xing, Chengguo; Qu, Zhuo; Yu, Jianqiang; Zhuang, Chunlin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂的分子杂交设计与活性验证，对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Blocking the Kelch-like epichlorohydrin-related protein 1 (Keap1)-nuclear factor-erythroid 2 related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathway represents as a promising strategy to reduce oxidative stress and related-inflammation, including acute lung injury (ALI). NXPZ-2, a naphthalensulfonamide derivative, was previously reported to effectively inhibit the Keap1-Nrf2 protein-protein interaction (PPI) by our group. In the present work, a series of novel isothiocyanate-containing naphthalensulfonamides with the thioether, sulfoxide and sulfone moieties were designed by a structure-based molecular hybridization strategy using NXPZ-2 and the Nrf2 activator sulforaphane. They possessed good Keap1-Nrf2 PPI inhibitory activity and low cytotoxicity. The molecular docking study was performed to further explain the different activity of the thioether-, sulfoxide- and sulfone-containing naphthalensulfonamides. Among these new derivatives, 2-((N-(4-((N-(2-amino-2-oxoethyl)-4-((3-isothiocyanatopropyl)sulfinyl)phenyl)sulfonamido) naphthalen-1-yl)-4-methoxyphenyl)sulfonamido)acetamide (SCN-16) showed a good K(D2) value of 0.455 muM to disrupt the PPI. In an LPS-induced peritoneal macrophage cell model, this compound could cause a significant increase in the nuclear Nrf2 protein, decrease in the cytosolic Nrf2 protein, and further elevate the downstream protective enzymes HO-1 and NQO-1, which were better than the lead compound NXPZ-2 and sulforaphane. What's more, the production of ROS and NO and the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokine TNF-alpha were also suppressed. In the LPS-induced ALI model, SCN-16 could significantly reduce LPS-induced inflammations and alleviate lung injuries by triggering Nrf2 nuclear translocation. Collectively, our results suggested that SCN-16 could be a novel lead compound targeting Keap1-Nrf2 protective pathway for clinical treatment of ALI.
abstract_zh: 阻断Kelch样环氧氯丙烷相关蛋白1（Keap1）-核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）通路被认为是减少氧化应激及相关炎症（包括急性肺损伤（ALI））的一种有前景的策略。NXPZ-2是一种萘磺酰胺衍生物，我们课题组此前报道其能有效抑制Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）。在本研究中，基于结构的分子杂交策略，以NXPZ-2和Nrf2激活剂萝卜硫素为模板，设计了一系列含有硫醚、亚砜和砜基团的新型含异硫氰酸酯的萘磺酰胺类化合物。这些化合物具有良好的Keap1-Nrf2 PPI抑制活性和低细胞毒性。通过分子对接研究进一步解释了含硫醚、亚砜和砜的萘磺酰胺类化合物活性差异的原因。在这些新衍生物中，2-((N-(4-((N-(2-氨基-2-氧代乙基)-4-((3-异硫氰酸丙基)亚磺酰基)苯基)磺酰胺基)萘-1-基)-4-甲氧基苯基)磺酰胺基)乙酰胺（SCN-16）表现出良好的K(D2)值（0.455 μM），能有效破坏PPI。在LPS诱导的腹腔巨噬细胞模型中，该化合物能显著增加核内Nrf2蛋白水平，降低胞浆中Nrf2蛋白水平，并进一步上调下游保护酶HO-1和NQO-1，效果优于先导化合物NXPZ-2和萝卜硫素。此外，ROS和NO的产生以及促炎细胞因子TNF-α的表达也受到抑制。在LPS诱导的ALI模型中，SCN-16能通过触发Nrf2核转位显著减少LPS诱导的炎症并减轻肺损伤。综上所述，我们的结果表明，SCN-16可能是一种靶向Keap1-Nrf2保护通路的新型先导化合物，用于ALI的临床治疗。
